h1: Where Can You Smoke Weed in Brooklyn & NYC?
excerpt: Cannabis is legal for adults 21 and older in New York, but that does not mean you can smoke or vape it everywhere in Brooklyn or New York City. The basic state rule is that cannabis smoking generally follows tobacco-smoking rules. In NYC, however, tobacco smoking is prohibited in a long list of public places – which means cannabis is prohibited there too.
html:
Cannabis is legal for adults 21 and older in New York, but that does not mean you can smoke or vape it everywhere in Brooklyn or New York City. The basic state rule is that cannabis smoking generally follows tobacco-smoking rules. In NYC, however, tobacco smoking is prohibited in a long list of public places – which means cannabis is prohibited there too.

Can you smoke weed on the sidewalk in Brooklyn?

In some locations, smoking on a public sidewalk may be permitted if that exact location is not covered by another smoke-free rule. But sidewalks can border places with special restrictions, and local rules are detailed enough that it is smart to check your surroundings rather than assuming every sidewalk is fair game.

If you are near a park, playground, school, hospital entrance, restaurant patio, pedestrian plaza, transit area, or another smoke-free property, move on and verify the rules before consuming.

Can you smoke weed in NYC parks?

No. Smoking and vaping cannabis are prohibited in New York City parks. That includes many of Brooklyn’s most popular green spaces. The same smoke-free rules cover beaches, boardwalks, pools, playgrounds, public golf courses, and other NYC Parks property.

Can you smoke weed at a restaurant or bar?

No. NYC’s Smoke-Free Air Act prohibits smoking and vaping cannabis at restaurants and bars, including outdoor dining areas. A patio, sidewalk cafe, or backyard dining area is not automatically a legal place to consume cannabis.

Can you smoke weed in a car?

No. Cannabis smoking and vaping are prohibited in motor vehicles, even if the vehicle is parked. Driving while impaired by cannabis is also illegal. Passengers cannot smoke cannabis in a vehicle either.

What about your apartment or Airbnb?

Private residences are different, but the property owner or building may restrict smoking or vaping. Landlords, rental companies, hotels, and short-term accommodations may have their own smoke-free policies. Before consuming indoors, check your lease, house rules, hotel policy, or host rules.

NYCHA housing is subject to separate smoke-free requirements, and federal property is subject to federal law, where cannabis remains illegal.

Can you smoke inside a cannabis dispensary?

Not simply because it sells cannabis. Retail dispensaries are businesses, and smoking or vaping is not allowed inside ordinary cannabis retail stores. New York has a separate licensing framework for on-site consumption; do not assume a dispensary is a consumption lounge unless it is specifically authorized for that use.

The easiest rule to remember

If tobacco smoking is prohibited, cannabis smoking is generally prohibited too – and cannabis has some additional restrictions of its own. In Brooklyn, avoid parks, beaches, restaurants and patios, vehicles, workplaces, federal property, and building common areas where smoking is prohibited.

Be a good Brooklyn neighbor

Legal does not always mean considerate. Brownstone Brooklyn is dense: stoops, playgrounds, restaurants, apartments, schools, and sidewalks often sit just feet apart. Even where smoking may be permitted, paying attention to neighbors and choosing a lower-impact location can make a meaningful difference.
